role_text:
Senior Simulation Engineer — Autonomous Vehicles

You will build and extend the simulation environment used to train and
validate autonomous vehicle behavior: a real-world-scale virtual city
where our AV stack drives millions of miles before it drives one real
one. The world must be believable enough that behavior learned in it
transfers to the street.

Responsibilities include procedural generation of road networks and
environments, behavioral modeling of pedestrians and other drivers,
real-time performance at scale, and building the content pipeline that
lets non-engineers author scenarios.

Requirements: strong C++, real-time engine experience, and a track
record building large simulated worlds that stay performant.
core_shape: Architecting and optimizing large-scale, real-time virtual environments where procedurally generated worlds and complex agent behaviors must run efficiently while maintaining high fidelity for downstream decision-making.

pools.name: Defense & Aviation Training Systems
pools.transfer_logic: They build high-fidelity, real-time virtual cockpits and battlefields where pilot/operator decision-making must transfer to reality, using procedural terrain generation and complex traffic/agent modeling under strict latency budgets.
tells: Heavy focus on motion platform integration or certification/compliance rather than pure software world-building
Profiles dominated by safety-critical documentation over scalable content pipelines or agent AI

pools.name: Virtual Production & Real-Time VFX Pipelines
pools.transfer_logic: They author massive, real-time 3D environments with complex lighting, physics, and crowd simulation that must run at broadcast frame rates, building heavy tooling so directors and artists can iterate without engineering bottlenecks.
tells: Heavy emphasis on offline rendering or compositing rather than real-time performance
Profiles show asset creation or shot delivery rather than engine architecture or agent behavior modeling

pools.name: Immersive Theme Park & Ride Control Systems
pools.transfer_logic: They engineer real-time, synchronized virtual environments with complex crowd/agent behaviors and procedural asset streaming that must run flawlessly at 60fps+ for live audiences, supported by designer-friendly authoring tools.
tells: Focus on ride mechanics, safety systems, or projection mapping rather than scalable world simulation or agent AI
Profiles show event-driven scripting or show control rather than engine-level optimization

pools.name: Military Wargaming & Tactical C2 Environments
pools.transfer_logic: They build real-time, large-scale virtual battlefields with adversarial agent AI and procedural terrain generation, requiring strict performance budgets and tooling for mission planners to author complex scenarios.
tells: Heavy reliance on legacy Java/Python stacks or offline batch processing rather than real-time C++ engines
Profiles emphasize data analytics or command interfaces over world simulation performance

pools.name: Warehouse & Logistics Robotics Testbeds
pools.transfer_logic: They construct real-time digital twins of massive fulfillment centers with thousands of interacting robots and dynamic obstacles, optimizing for sim-to-real transfer and building scenario authoring tools for operations teams.
tells: Focus on single-robot kinematics or offline scheduling rather than large-scale world simulation
Profiles show heavy Python/MATLAB usage without real-time engine optimization experience
